newsitem.title: PUERTO RICO: Three rescued in Caribbean after nine days at sea.
newsitem.headline: Three rescued in Caribbean after nine days at sea.

text.p: Three fishermen from Dominica were rescued on Friday after spending nine days drifting through the Caribbean Sea, the U.S. Coast Guard said on Saturday.
The men were sighted south of the U.S. Virgin Island St. Croix on Friday afternoon by a passing tanker, which reported to the Coast Guard that it had spotted a disabled 20-foot (7 meter) boat.

A U.S. Navy patrol boat was sent to the scene and found Sam Frank, Cliff Joseph and Felix Langis, all from the Caribbean island nation Dominica, who had last been seen on October 30 when they departed for a two-day fishing trip. A friend reported them missing November 4.
Despite their long journey a medical examination showed the three men were in good condition, the Coast Guard said.
